about: Every capability of the True Tunes web app (PWA) and the plumbing under it. `passes` turns true only after the check in `how_verified` has run and passed; `evidence` is the command or screenshot that showed it. Derived from the SonosPreload contract (renderer/src/types/globals.d.ts, 97 methods, each named in exactly one `bridge` list below) and the routes in renderer/src/App.tsx. Never delete or loosen an entry to make the list look finished.

features.description: The gateway serves the built web app's files: `/` and unknown extension-less paths give index.html (SPA fallback), files under the web root are served with their type, nothing outside the root can be read, and reserved prefixes (/sonos, /fn, /img, /healthz) never fall through to it.
features.how_verified: server unit tests (gatewayStatic.test.ts, gatewayHttp.test.ts); then curl against production

features.description: index.html, the service worker and the manifest are served `no-cache`; hashed files under /assets/ are `public, max-age=31536000, immutable`.
features.how_verified: server unit tests; `curl -sI` of each on production

features.description: `ANY /fn/<path>` is forwarded to https://truetunes-fn.azurewebsites.net/api/<path> for a caller with a valid Entra ID token. The caller's Authorization header goes through untouched and the gateway adds no credential. /fn/sonos-session is refused, so the Sonos session cannot be fetched through the gateway.
features.how_verified: server unit tests (gatewayHttp.test.ts); curl on production shows 401 without a token
features.evidence: `cd server && npm test` (585 pass); `node scripts/web/checks.mjs https://truetunes.tnapps.co.uk`: 28 of 28 PASS on 12 Nov 2026 after the deploy of aa722d7 (Publish run 43287133370). Production: /fn/stats 401 with no token and with a made-up one; /fn/sonos-session 404 in four spellings.

features.description: `GET /img?url=` fetches artwork from a named list of https hosts for a signed-in caller. Any other host, scheme, port or a redirect is refused; only image responses are passed back. It is not an open proxy.
features.how_verified: server unit tests; curl on production shows a refusal for a host not on the list
features.evidence: `cd server && npm test` (585 pass); `node scripts/web/checks.mjs https://truetunes.tnapps.co.uk`: 28 of 28 PASS on 12 Nov 2026 after the deploy of aa722d7 (Publish run 43287133370). Production: three hosts off the list refused with 403; a listed host 401 without a token.

features.description: The WebSocket relay accepts a browser, which cannot set headers: the Entra ID token travels as a `bearer.<token>` WebSocket subprotocol value, never in the URL. The desktop's Authorization header path still works.
features.how_verified: server unit tests (gatewayRelay.test.ts); a local run of the gateway accepts and refuses real `ws` clients; production refuses an unauthenticated upgrade
features.evidence: `cd server && npm test` (585 pass); `node scripts/web/checks.mjs https://truetunes.tnapps.co.uk`: 28 of 28 PASS on 12 Nov 2026 after the deploy of aa722d7 (Publish run 43287133370). Unit: gatewayRelay.test.ts (bearer subprotocol), gatewayNode.test.ts (a real ws server selects only the Sonos subprotocol). Local run of the built gateway and production both refuse a made-up token as a subprotocol and as a header with 401.

features.description: Nothing under /sonos/api/auth is forwarded, and unauthenticated calls to /sonos, /fn and the relay are refused, on production.
features.how_verified: curl and a `ws` client against https://truetunes.tnapps.co.uk
features.evidence: `cd server && npm test` (585 pass); `node scripts/web/checks.mjs https://truetunes.tnapps.co.uk`: 28 of 28 PASS on 12 Nov 2026 after the deploy of aa722d7 (Publish run 43287133370). Production: /sonos/api/..., /sonos/api/auth/session, /fn/... and the relay all refuse a caller with no token (401, the gateway's own "sign-in required").

features.description: Live 'who queued this' events reach the browser through the gateway (a relay to the Web PubSub socket), so the browser stays on one origin.
features.how_verified: server unit tests; mock-driven bridge test

features.description: A web build of the renderer (`npm run build:web`) from the same components, with its own entry and index.html; the pipeline builds it and ships it inside the gateway zip. The Electron build is unchanged.
features.how_verified: `npm run build:web` and `npm run build` both succeed; the deploy job's log; production serves the app shell

features.description: A browser implementation of `window.sonos` that satisfies the whole SonosPreload type, chosen at start-up when there is no Electron preload.
features.how_verified: `npm run typecheck` (fails if a method is missing); unit tests of the bridge

features.description: Window controls, the mini player window, the debug windows and taskbar/media-key integration are hidden or no-ops on the web.
features.how_verified: unit test of the web bridge's no-ops; screenshot of the web shell with no window controls

features.description: /demo runs the whole app against the bundled mock backend: lazy-loaded, no sign-in, labelled as a demo, with playback, volume and queue changes simulated in memory. It never calls /sonos, /fn or the relay.
features.how_verified: Playwright journey test against the local gateway and against production, asserting no request leaves for /sonos, /fn or the relay

features.description: Sign-in with @azure/msal-browser, redirect flow, cache in localStorage, on the existing app registration and one of its registered redirect addresses. Sign out and switch account work.
features.how_verified: unit tests with a fake MSAL client; Playwright reaches the Microsoft sign-in page with the right client id and redirect_uri. A real sign-in needs the owner.

features.description: The app's ready, expired and failed states on the web: ready once signed in and the relay is up, failed (with Retry) when the gateway refuses the token.
features.how_verified: unit tests of the bridge

features.description: The display name: looked up from the profile for this Entra account, claimed, kept in localStorage, and changeable.
features.how_verified: unit tests of the bridge's request mapping

features.description: Our Functions' read calls go through /fn with the caller's token: users, profiles, stats, recently played, the DJ set, music stats, the daily game and its boards, playlists, polls.
features.how_verified: unit tests asserting each call's method, path and query against the desktop's (src/ipc/functions.ts)

features.description: Our Functions' write calls through /fn: playlists (create, update, delete, tracks, join, image), favourites, profile image, Queuedle score, poll answer and admin, feedback, track metadata.
features.how_verified: unit tests asserting method, path and body against a fake fetch. Never run against production.

features.description: Who queued what: the map is loaded from /fn/attribution and refreshed when the queue changes; queueing publishes the event (/fn/log-event) and shows the badge at once.
features.how_verified: unit tests of the bridge; demo journey shows queued-by badges

features.description: Office presence from Microsoft Graph for the Discover room. Falls back to 'none' (the room is inferred from recent queueing) when there is no consent.
features.how_verified: unit test of the fallback and of the Graph mapping

features.description: The DJ (autoplay) works on the web as on the desktop: the upcoming picks, the on/off switch, and the coordinator's filler position, so people's picks go in front of the DJ's. The web client takes part in the 30-second enqueue lease like any other client.
features.how_verified: unit test: the web bridge sends the same request as the desktop (src/ipc/functions.ts)

features.description: Sonos reads through /sonos/api: every operationId the renderer uses maps to the same method and path as the desktop, with household, service, group and queue ids filled in, GETs retried on 5xx, and the default music service discovered and self-healed.
features.how_verified: unit tests: URL building per operation, retry, discovery; a test that the operation table matches src/sonos-api.ts

features.description: Live state over the relay: connect with the token subprotocol, bootstrap (household, devices, subscriptions), groups, playback and volume pushes for the active group only, reconnect with backoff, resync.
